review_policy: Use real preserved pixels. Compare resource labels and order, numeric alignment, panel chrome, surrounding dock/action controls, font rendering and visible capture extent. Real layout/OS/rendering variation is recorded; a number or date alone is not a build identifier. Equivalence is limited to the observed resource-reader contract.
